summary: Not every production failure can be reduced to a deterministic unit test, and a faithful reproducer can still encode the wrong requirement.

points.text: Concurrency, timing, distributed state and third-party failures may resist deterministic local reproduction. Preserve the evidence and classify the uncertainty instead of fabricating a green unit test.
A regression test can faithfully reproduce a misunderstood report. Acceptance criteria and domain review are still needed to establish that the observed behavior is actually wrong.
Running every check after every edit can make the loop unusably slow. Use the smallest reproducer during diagnosis, then widen to the relevant suite before claiming proof.
A temporary revert or baseline checkout must not destroy unrelated work; use an isolated worktree, clean revision or equivalent controlled comparison.
